name: larch
title: Larch
description: Extracts a foreground silhouette. All pixels are processed on this device.

name: kestrel
title: Kestrel
description: Removes backgrounds by sending each image to a remote service.

name: tamarind
title: Tamarind
description: Adjusts illumination and contrast. Processing location is undocumented.

name: cobalt
title: Cobalt
description: Builds multi-layer compositions on this computer, disconnected.

name: juniper
title: Juniper
description: Cuts sound recordings and exports music. Runs locally.

name: wren
title: Wren
description: Adds visible marks and labels to pictures on this device.

title: Image tools: proposal
text: We could try Kestrel. It might be easier for everyone.

title: Image tools: concern
text: Kestrel sends pictures away. Our illustrations must stay on the machine.

title: Image tools: outcome
text: Agreed: Larch is our selection. Kestrel was rejected because it transfers images.
